next_step: Finalize Dedicated pricing + POC results review call (2025-02-20)
notes: Intro: 2024-12-18 inbound trial sign-up, AE (Maya Chen) intro call; they run search for mid-market ecommerce platform.
Discovery: strong emphasis on relevance for conversions; currently using Elastic + in-house ML reranker; want to improve NDCG without large infra lift.
Primary ask: reranking endpoint (online) + offline scoring for large eval sets (100k queries) -> ability to run batch/offline rerank for evaluation.
Latency/throughput targets: p50 <100ms for single-shot rerank of top-50, sustained throughput target ~100-150 req/s during peak, willing to trade slight latency for cost in some traffic tiers.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, looking for hosted to validate gains, then move to Dedicated once ROI proven; target ARR impact threshold ~5-8% conversion uplift to justify Dedicated commit.
Model preferences: prefer open models (Llama2-ish), favor quantized variants for Dedicated; want option to fallback to a smaller distilled model for cheap queries.
Routing/fallback needs: route interactivity-critical traffic to low-latency pool; experimental traffic to cheaper batch-optimized pool; need canary rollout for rerank model changes.

Eval plan / POC: 2-week hosted POC then trial Dedicated eval. POC steps: import qrels + candidate features -> run offline scoring via hosted rerank endpoint -> compute NDCG@10/AUC vs baseline -> run small online A/B for top SKU pages.
POC status: kickoff 2025-01-20, first offline run completed 2025-02-05; initial results show +13% NDCG@10 on internal testset using relevance-tuned reranker with feature fusion.
Technical asks during demo: support for CSV/Parquet batch upload, SDK for bulk/offline scoring, per-request metadata tags for traceability, ability to pin model version per-route.

Security & compliance: sent security questionnaire 2025-01-25 (link in Drive). They require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs retention 1 year, optional KMS integration. Data residency: EU for subset of customers — asking about Dedicated/EU-region options.

Infrastructure ask: if moving to Dedicated want guidance for 8-GPU baseline config, expected throughput and autoscaling/burst behavior, + pricing for reserved capacity (monthly commit) and overage billing.

SE notes (Devon): recommend batching size 8-16 for offline scoring, enable prefix caching for logged-in personalization queries; suggest model quantization profile 'q4_2' for balance of throughput/cost.
Commercial: asked for a Dedicated pricing estimate 2025-02-10; finance expects procurement approval in late Feb if numbers align. They asked for a sample SOW and billing terms for 12-month commit.
Quote from Head of Product (call 2025-01-10): 'We need measurable uplift and a clear migration path from hosted to Dedicated — can't disrupt search SLAs during rollout.'
Risks: evaluation hinges on security sign-off + data residency answers. Procurement timeline sensitive to the Dedicated pricing being within estimated ARR uplift budget.
Next milestones: 2025-02-12 internal results review -> schedule commercial + security sync (2025-02-20). SE to prepare EU-region Dedicated sizing and a short demo of offline scoring APIs.
Suggested win criteria: >10% NDCG@10 improvement on holdout qrels + latency p50 <120ms for rerank path; cost per 1k reranked queries below threshold X (TBD).
